name: Faithlessness
overview: Scripture reveals faithlessness as a serious condition marked by the absence of truth, mercy, and knowledge of God, leading to spiritual ruin and divine judgment. Hosea highlights the broken relationship caused by unfaithfulness, while Luke questions whether genuine faith will be found upon Christ's return. Romans teaches that unbelief cannot nullify God's faithfulness, yet acting without faith is sin and brings condemnation. Ultimately, Revelation warns that the unbelieving will face eternal separation from God, emphasizing the vital importance of steadfast faith in the believer's life.
